mechanism.claim: A large Saturday-Sunday BTC range that closes in the directional outer quartile has been accepted, rather than rejected, by continuous crypto liquidity. Follow that accepted weekend repricing through the first full Monday UTC day when broader participation returns.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed 48-hour weekend displacement
mechanism.why_distinct: WHVOF fades incomplete 12-hour moves inside the weekend. WMLHR waits through Monday 08:00 and requires an opposite-direction liquidity handoff. HVWAR waits for the entire weekend, requires terminal range acceptance, enters before Monday price information, and follows rather than repairs either event law.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: completed weekend high-low range rank at least 0.65 against strictly prior weekends
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: at most one Monday 00:05 UTC position per week and a weekend-only acceptance state are absent from Gross9

features.weekend: exact 576 completed contiguous BTCUSDT 5m bars [Saturday 00:00, Monday 00:00)
features.validity: unique exact grid, finite positive coherent OHLC, no imputation
features.displacement: log(Sunday 23:55 close / Saturday 00:00 open), strict nonzero
features.range: log(max high / min low), finite strict positive
features.directional_acceptance: close_location>=0.75 for positive displacement or <=0.25 for negative displacement
features.range_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid completed weekends, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact Monday 00:00 UTC after Sunday 23:55 bar completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

definitions.no_range_gate: full-weekend directional acceptance without the range-rank gate
definitions.no_acceptance_gate: range-ranked full weekend with any strict nonzero displacement, same displacement side
definitions.central_close_rejection: primary range gate, close location in [0.40,0.60], opposite displacement side
definitions.sunday_only_geometry: exact Sunday 00:00-Monday 00:00 range, displacement, acceptance, and its own strictly-prior weekend rank law
definitions.direction_flip: negative primary side on the primary clock

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no weekend, rank, acceptance, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
